name: Why is quick action important for sewage damaged drywall?

mainEntity.name: Why is quick action important for sewage damaged drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediate action is critical when dealing with sewage-damaged drywall to prevent escalating health risks and structural deterioration. Sewage breeds harmful bacteria and viruses, which can multiply rapidly and spread through the air. The moisture also promotes aggressive mold growth within 24-48 hours, exacerbating health issues and causing further damage to the building structure, including wood rot and weakening. Swift professional intervention minimizes contamination, reduces repair costs, and helps restore a safe environment faster.
acceptedAnswer.description: Quick action is vital to prevent rapid health risks from pathogens and mold, and to stop further structural damage. It helps minimize contamination and reduce repair costs.
